messages:
Maya Singh: Morning — quick async micro-standup from product. What I did: consolidated launch checklist and talked to legal about data retention. Blockers: waiting on infra perf numbers for routing change. Today: write changelog blurb, finalize spec responses.
Jared Cole: Merged routing fix into canary, kicked off perf run last night. Seeing some variance in p99 across regions.
Priya Patel: Blocked on infra spec feedback re: KV cache behavior; left a comment in the spec doc, @Tess can you weigh in on client-visible changes?
Tess Nguyen: Saw the comment — I'll review the spec this morning and add a tiny section on backward compatibility. Uploaded notes here: https://internal.docs/redwood/specs/embedding-rollout 
Maya Singh: Thanks. Also noticed p99 spikes for longer sequences after the canary. @Jared can you paste the perf log snippet?
Jared Cole: Quick snippet: ```json
{ "req_id": "canary-42", "seq_len": 128, "p99_ms": 920, "kv_cache_enabled": true }
``` Logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/42. Looks like KV cache churn when prefix length > 64.
eng-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment v2.4 -> 3 nodes complete (started 1723449000). :white_check_mark:
Priya Patel: Ok — I'll run a targeted smoke with `kv_cache_enabled=false` on a single canary node and report results (~2h).
Tess Nguyen: For launch checklist: items left = docs PR, client changelog, QA signoff, telemetry dashboard. I can own the docs PR. @Maya can you draft the changelog blurb?
Maya Singh: Yep, will draft by noon. Draft changelog: "Routing fix improves median latency and reduces p99 for long-context requests by ~12% (canary)." Will open a PR to the website.
Jared Cole: CR ping: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 — small batching policy change (adaptive window). @Priya please review when you can.
Priya Patel: On it, aiming to finish review in ~90m. If I find perf regressions I'll flag here.
Maya Singh: Prioritization question: product is asking if we should feature-flag the embed-cache rollout or go full ramp. Thoughts?
Tess Nguyen: Recommend feature-flag with 10% ramp next week; we need the telemetry dashboard before wider rollout. Safer for customer impact.
Jared Cole: I can wire the dashboard tiles today and populate mock metrics. Will post link here when done.
eng-bot: metrics-bot: /dash/embedding-cache created and seeded with sample data (0 -> 50 rps).
Priya Patel: If the dashboard looks good we can do the 10% ramp and run a 24h smoke. No other infra blockers from my side.
Maya Singh: Great — plan: Jared builds dashboard, Tess merges docs PR, I write changelog, Priya runs the smoke. If all green, feature-flag 10% next Tue. Ping me for anything urgent or if timelines slip. :rocket:
